svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)

The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances. The two clock domains are asynchronous: the register side runs on the BUS clock, the protocol side on the CAN clock, and u_canfd_cdc holds the synchronizers and handshakes between them. Connections of u_canfd_pwr, u_canfd_pn, u_canfd_tt, u_canfd_ts, u_canfd_safe and u_canfd_rst to the other blocks are many-to-many and are listed in sections 7 and 18. With PARA_CANFD_SAF_DUP_EN=1, u_canfd_safe also contains the delayed duplicate protocol core (section 18.3.4).
Structural top of the CAN FD controller: message handling and registers in the BUS domain, bit timing and protocol in the CAN domain, clock domain
Reset synchronizers of the two domains
Generated APB register block (APB-CSR-Generator, not hand-written)
APB write filter for the protected registers (INIT, CCE, lock)
Clock domain crossings CDC-003 to CDC-009 (wrapper of the synchronizer, handshake and toggle modules)
Frame state machine and field control
Error counters, fault confinement, last error code
Rx handler: storing, FIFO indexes, new-data flags
Tx handler: scan, fetch, cancel, event
Message RAM master port and access watchdog
Power state, clock stop, wake-up, bus select, transceiver control
